name: security-agent-command-approval-binding-review
intent: Approval-to-command binding across agent execution and retries
artifacts: Approval UI/record, executor arguments, shell expansion, working directory and retry logic.
trace: Trace the exact reviewed action into the executed process, including changed arguments, environment, cwd or substituted scripts after approval.
experiment: Use inert local command stubs that record argv/cwd; compare an approved action and a deliberately modified subsequent action.
disproof: An approval for a displayed command is not a generic grant to related actions; conversely, repeated approval is unnecessary when the actual authorized action is unchanged.
repair: Bind approval to the security-relevant execution object and preserve legitimate idempotent retries.
branch_decisions: Bind approval to executable, argv, working directory, environment and relevant script/input identity. Textually identical shell commands can execute changed files or resolve a different executable. Distinguish an intentionally approved general shell capability from approval of one immutable operation, and verify whether retries or edits invalidate the specific approval contract.
